response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack development skills and a broad technical background, but his experience lacks direct alignment with the core requirements of the role, particularly in C++ on Windows and fixed-income/capital-markets domain expertise. His profile is more suited to web/mobile development and open-source projects, though his problem-solving and leadership abilities are notable.
strengths: Diverse technical background with experience in multiple languages and frameworks, showcasing adaptability.
Strong leadership and mentorship through workshops, talks, and open-source contributions (e.g., GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts).
Proven ability to work in high-performance environments (e.g., Dunnhumby media's low-latency systems).
concerns: Limited recent C++ experience (only mentioned briefly in 2014–2015 at National Instruments) and no explicit Windows platform focus.
No demonstrated experience in fixed-income, capital markets, or investment banking domains.
Primary expertise lies in web/mobile development (TypeScript, Node.js, React) rather than the required financial systems.
